decision: Retain the exact remaining-menu implementation and all paired evidence; close this independent algorithm-contribution route under the preregistered novelty condition.
reason: The surviving mechanism instantiates standard rollout, relevant-information reduction and context caching. Correctness, throughput and development-cohort gains are established; an independent method contribution is not.
scope: This closure concerns the present algorithm-method route, not all possible modeling or empirical contributions of the project.
fixed: V39 physical model, emission model, menus, public information, 148 original states and 72 roots on six development dates; no refit or new actual dates.
budget_scope: Cooperative per-decision CPU allowance; late work is charged but excluded from the returned empirical incumbent. Actual decision CPU feasibility precedes quality interpretation. No hard-deadline guarantee.
preservation: All original six nonzero cases, new gains and harms, ties, over-budget work, 18 new public-state calls and unresolved conditional samples remain in the raw receipts and summary.
next_step: Stage closed. No automatic additional algorithm variants, sample extensions, seed search or new-date campaign.
